title: A game about space
blurb: Why one computer game is still the favourite.

paragraphs.zh: 我的爱好是跑步和玩电脑游戏。我玩过很多游戏，可是我最喜欢的游戏在太空里。
paragraphs.en: My hobbies are running and computer games. I've played lots of games, but my favourite one takes place in space.

paragraphs.zh: 在这个游戏里，你坐飞船去很多星球。每个星球都有一个故事。
paragraphs.en: In this game you fly a spaceship to lots of planets. Every planet has a story.

paragraphs.zh: 没有人告诉你应该做什么。你需要慢慢发现这个世界的历史。
paragraphs.en: Nobody tells you what you should do. You have to slowly discover the history of this world.

paragraphs.zh: 我第一次玩的时候，有一点害怕，可是我越来越有兴趣。
paragraphs.en: The first time I played, I was a little scared, but I got more and more interested.

paragraphs.zh: 女朋友说：“你说这个游戏的时候，跟说跑步一样高兴！”
paragraphs.en: My girlfriend says: "When you talk about this game, you're as happy as when you talk about running!"
